generic_name: Malt and Hawthorn (Crataegus species extract with malt base)
purpose: Hawthorn is a natural herbal supplement that has been used for centuries to support heart health. It is commonly used to help with mild heart function issues, improve blood flow, and support healthy blood pressure levels. Malt serves as a natural base or carrier that may also provide mild nutritional support.
how_it_works: Hawthorn contains natural plant compounds called flavonoids and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs) that help relax and widen blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. These compounds also act as antioxidants, protecting heart cells from damage. The malt base provides gentle energy support and helps the body absorb the active ingredients.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate this supplement well. Some people may experience mild stomach upset, nausea, dizziness, headache, or a feeling of fatigue, especially when first starting it. These effects are usually mild and go away on their own.
warnings: Do not use this supplement as a replacement for prescribed heart medications without talking to your doctor first. If you have a serious heart condition, check with your doctor before taking hawthorn. It may interact with heart medications like digoxin or blood pressure drugs. Avoid if you are pregnant or breastfeeding unless advised by your healthcare provider. Stop use and contact your doctor if you notice chest pain, difficulty breathing, or worsening symptoms.
typical_dosing: A common dose of hawthorn extract is 160 to 900 mg per day, often divided into 2 to 3 doses with meals. Always follow the directions on the product label or as advised by your healthcare provider, since doses can vary between different brands and formulations.
